description: This Java class defines the 'DeleteConnection' command, which is used to delete a connection in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing the command, serializing/deserializing from JSON, and accessing command properties.

classes.name: DeleteConnection
classes.description: A command to delete a Connection object identified by ConnectionId, serializable to/from JSON, with headers and schema version support.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteConnection with specified ConnectionId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a DeleteConnection command from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this delete command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteConnection with the specified headers.
